hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes reduced endosome pH compared with APOE3.

paper.title: Lysosomal proteomics reveals mechanisms of neuronal APOE4-associated lysosomal dysfunction.

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal pH was measured ratiometrically with OregonGreen-dextran (pulse-chase, then calibrated by pH-clamping) in Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4 or APOE3 from the genomic locus. APOE4 cells had a higher, more alkaline lysosomal pH (5.86) than APOE3 cells (4.30). This is the opposite direction to the hypothesized APOE4-induced reduction in pH. The compartment measured is the lysosome rather than the endosome, so B is a closely related surrogate compartment.
findings.quote: We found that HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibit dramatic lysosomal alkalinization (pH = 5.86) compared to HsAPOE3 (pH = 4.30) cells (Figure 1C–E)
findings.summary: In APOE4 Neuro-2a cells, lysosomal pH was higher (alkaline) than in APOE3 cells, contradicting the hypothesized pH reduction.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 (genomic locus transgene)

findings.finding_description: Acidic compartments were stained with LysoTracker in APOE3 and APOE4 Neuro-2a cells. LysoTracker intensity was significantly reduced in APOE4 cells. Because LAMP1 lysosomal density was not decreased, the authors interpret this as reduced acidity, which argues against the hypothesized APOE4-induced pH reduction.
findings.quote: We found that the LysoTracker intensity was significantly reduced in HsAPOE4-expressing cells (Figure 1A,B), suggesting either endolysosomal alkalinization or a reduction in endolysosomal density.
findings.summary: APOE4 cells showed lower LysoTracker staining, consistent with less acidic endolysosomes.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: OregonGreen-dextran lysosomal pH was compared across APOE3, APOE4 and parental cells lacking human APOE. APOE4 lysosomes were alkaline relative to the parental cells (pH 4.58), whereas APOE3 and parental cells had comparable pH. The APOE4 effect therefore appears to be a gain of alkalinization, not acidification.
findings.quote: This alkalinization was also observed in comparison to the parental cell line in which no human APOE had been introduced (referred to as HsAPOE−/−, pH = 4.58). In contrast, the lysosomal pH was comparable between HsAPOE3 and HsAPOE−/− cells (Figure 1E).
findings.summary: APOE4 alkalinizes lysosomes relative to no-human-APOE controls, while APOE3 does not change lysosomal pH.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a cells: parental (HsAPOE−/−), HsAPOE3 and HsAPOE4

findings.finding_description: Lysosomes were stained for LAMP1 to test whether the reduced LysoTracker signal in APOE4 cells reflected lower lysosome density. Lysosomal density was not decreased in APOE4 cells, which supports reduced acidity as the explanation for the LysoTracker drop.
findings.quote: We therefore stained the cells for the lysosomal membrane marker LAMP1, finding that the lysosomal density was not decreased in HsAPOE4 cells (Fig. S1B-C).
findings.summary: APOE4 did not reduce LAMP1 lysosome density, supporting alkalinization as the cause of the lower LysoTracker signal.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4
findings._note: Class 5 because B (pH) is not measured; this is a control for the LysoTracker surrogate, measuring lysosome density.

findings.finding_description: Magic Red Cathepsin B was used as a readout of lysosomal proteolysis, which depends on acidic pH. APOE4 cells showed significantly decreased cleavage compared with APOE3 cells. This is a downstream functional surrogate that is consistent with less acidic lysosomes in APOE4.
findings.quote: We found that the HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibited significantly decreased MR-CTSB proteolysis compared to HsAPOE3-expressing cells, in line with their decreased lysosomal acidity (Figure 1F,G).
findings.summary: APOE4 reduced cathepsin B activity, consistent with less acidic lysosomes.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: In APOE4 Neuro-2a cells, the lysosomal protein TMED5 (which accumulates in APOE4 lysosomes) was knocked down by siRNA. Knockdown significantly enhanced lysosomal acidification as measured by OregonGreen, without changing lysosome density. This implicates TMED5 accumulation as a mediator of APOE4-associated alkalinization.
findings.quote: We confirmed by lysosomal Oregon-green pH measurements that knockdown of TMED5 significantly enhanced lysosomal acidification in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, while not impacting the lysosomal density (Figure 5C–E).
findings.summary: Knocking down TMED5 re-acidified APOE4 lysosomes, supporting a TMED5-mediated APOE4 alkalinization mechanism.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a HsAPOE4 cells with siRNA knockdown of Tmed5

findings.finding_description: In APOE3 Neuro-2a cells, human TMED5-GFP was overexpressed to mimic APOE4-associated TMED5 accumulation. Overexpression decreased LysoTracker staining, a surrogate for reduced acidity.
findings.quote: Conversely, in HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells we found that TMED5 overexpression caused the opposite phenotype, resulting in decreased LysoTracker staining (Figure 5J,K) and lysosomal proteolysis (Figure 5L,M).
findings.summary: Overexpressing TMED5 in APOE3 cells reduced LysoTracker staining and proteolysis.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a HsAPOE3 cells overexpressing human TMED5-GFP

findings.finding_description: In APOE3 Neuro-2a cells, LGALS3BP (which is depleted in APOE4 lysosomes) was knocked down. Knockdown modestly alkalinized lysosomal pH by OregonGreen and nearly halved lysosome density.
findings.quote: we loaded the Neuro-2a cells with Dextran-Oregon Green, finding that LGALS3BP knockdown modestly alkalinized the lysosomal pH, but nearly halved the lysosomal density (Figure 4C–E).
findings.summary: Mimicking the APOE4-associated loss of LGALS3BP in APOE3 cells modestly alkalinized lysosomes.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a HsAPOE3 cells with siRNA knockdown of Lgals3bp

findings.finding_description: FCCP-induced mitophagy, read out by mtKeima, was weaker in APOE4 cells. Blocking acidification with BafA1 abolished the APOE3/APOE4 difference, which the authors take as indicating defective lysosomal acidification in APOE4. This is an indirect, acidity-dependent surrogate readout.
findings.quote: While BafA1 as expected reduced the acidic mtKeima signal, it intriguingly also abrogated the difference between HsAPOE3- and HsAPOE4-expressing cells (Figure 1I), suggesting that mitophagic defects could be attributed to defective lysosomal acidification.
findings.summary: The APOE4 mitophagy deficit disappeared with BafA1, consistent with an acidification defect in APOE4.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4, mtKeima reporter
